items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: (To the question) Behold, the coupling of the upper Aba and Ima never ceases at all, for it is to give life to the worlds, and were it to cease, the destruction of the worlds would immediately follow. And at the time of the birth of ZA, Aba and Ima must adapt their coupling to the need of the Mochin of the nursing of ZA, which is the phase of VAK. Hence there are two opposing actions here, that on the one hand Aba and Ima must be in a face-to-face coupling that does not cease, and on the other hand Aba and Ima must diminish to the phase of VAK, in order to clothe the Mochin in the phase of Katnut, in keeping with ZA at that time. Hence they divide again into two Partzufim, as at first before the pregnancy, so that Aba and Ima return to their phase in a face-to-face coupling that does not cease. And Yeshsut diminishes, in the secret of crouching, to the phase of VAK, in order to clothe the Mochin of the Katnut of ZA. (Item 105).
